title: Percona: ProxySQL writer failover + RTO
description: Runs `nexus failover-test cluster percona`: stops nexus-percona on the current ProxySQL writer, measures how fast ProxySQL promotes a backup_writer to writer (hostgroup 10), then restarts the stopped node.

observe.what: original writer -> new writer; RTO timeline. Live: ~2.3s.
a different node now holds hostgroup 10 ONLINE

whatProves: PerconaAdapter.FailoverAsync demonstrates the real HA primitive (ADR-0025): ProxySQL re-routes writes to a promoted backup_writer when the writer dies; the Galera cluster stays writable.
